name: Shaker Hot Chicken Salad

ingredients.name: unsalted butter, plus more for greasing baking pan

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Lightly grease a 2–quart baking dish, such as an 8x8 pan.

In a small saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Add flour and cook, stirring constantly, until it turns light brown and begins to smell nutty, 2 to 3 minutes. Gradually whisk in chicken stock and milk and bring to a simmer over medium. Reduce heat to low and gently simmer, stirring constantly, until thickened to a gravy-like texture, 4 to 6 minutes.

In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, mustard, onion powder, dried tarragon, salt, and black pepper. Whisk in warm prepared chicken sauce. Add chicken, celery, and pecans, and stir to evenly combine. Transfer mixture to prepared baking dish and spread into an even layer. Sprinkle crushed potato chips over the top.
Bake until bubbling and lightly browned on top, about 30 minutes. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

schema_metadata.keywords: chicken salad recipe, chicken casserole recicpe, hot chicken salad, Shaker Hot Chicken Salad

description: This Shaker hot chicken salad—creamy, tangy, and capped with a crunchy potato chip topping—gets a thoughtful upgrade with a quick homemade sauce, Dijon mustard, and dried tarragon.
notes:
Optional substitutions: diced poached chicken → roasted chicken or store-bought rotisserie chicken; homemade chicken stock → store-bought low-sodium chicken broth

Make-ahead and storage: Leftovers can be refrigerated up to 3 days, though the potato chip topping will get soggy. Reheat in 175°C (350°F) oven, covered loosely with aluminum foil if needed to prevent burning, until warmed through.
author: Jed Portman
